item.title: Thinking Machines Open-Sources 594B-Parameter 4-Bit Trained Model
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab has fulfilled its promise by open-sourcing Inkling 2 Small under Apache 2.0, a 594B-parameter model trained with native 4-bit forward passes from the first pretraining step through the final RL rollout. The 4-bit approach cut pretraining time by 8% and RL time by 20% for roughly 2% efficiency loss, and the released checkpoint requires no separate calibration.

原文标题：Thinking Machines 开源 594B 参数 4-bit 训练模型

Why it matters：端到端 4-bit 训练在超大规模模型上落地并开源，为低精度训练与推理提供了可复现的工程范式。

item.title: Microsoft Apologizes for Global Outage Caused by Network Capacity Upgrade
item.description:
Microsoft apologized for the global outage on November 12 that hit core Microsoft 365 cloud services and the connectivity components used by OpenAI and Anthropic. The company confirmed the fault stemmed from an issue in an earlier network capacity upgrade exposed by a later network change, unrelated to cyberattacks or AI. The underlying issue is resolved, services are largely restored, and a full postmortem is pending.

原文标题：微软全球服务中断致歉 网络容量升级引发

Why it matters：头部云厂商大规模故障波及主流 AI 服务连接层，是评估云基础设施韧性的重要事件。

item.title: Ratatui Maintainer Proposes New Terminal Border Protocol
item.description:
Josh McKinney, maintainer of Ratatui, has proposed a terminal protocol that draws thin lines on cell edges, enabling borders without consuming extra character cells. The approach targets the limitations of Unicode Box Drawing characters in TUI design and is currently at the discussion and prototype stage, with feedback sought in the Ghostty community.

原文标题：Ratatui 维护者提出终端边框新协议

item.title: Jensen Huang Exit Deals Blow to AI Startup Funding Ecosystem
item.description:
Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down after 33 years, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. As one of the most prolific AI investors—participating in 105 rounds this year alone, often as lead—Nvidia's potential shift in investment direction threatens a capital gap for AI-native startups, with VCs warning of impacts on dealmaking, valuations, and competition.

原文标题：黄仁勋卸任英伟达 CEO 引发 AI 创投圈震荡

Why it matters：英伟达掌舵人更替直接牵动 AI 创投最大资金来源，对初创生态与估值体系影响深远。

item.title: Reason Machines Launches Coding Harness Cutting Task Costs by 22%
item.description:
Reason Machines released Reason, a coding harness that keeps the prompt prefix byte-identical across turns to trigger OpenAI's prefix-caching discount, cutting repeated-token billing from $10 to $1 per million. It claims better Terminal-Bench and DeepSWE results than leading harnesses at 22% lower cost per task than OpenAI Codex.

原文标题：Reason Machines 推出编码 harness 成本降 22%

Why it matters：以提示前缀缓存实现显著降本的工程思路具体可复用，对构建编码智能体的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore V2 Uses Snapshots to Speed Session Startup
item.description:
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime introduces platformVersion V2, which prepares the environment once, snapshots it, and restores that snapshot per session instead of initializing a container each time, yielding faster and more consistent session starts. V2 also reclaims unused session memory so billing tracks actual usage; most agents benefit from a simple version switch, while some need restructuring.

原文标题：亚马逊 Bedrock AgentCore V2 快照恢复加速会话启动

Why it matters：这是智能体托管运行时在会话启动机制上的实质架构优化，对构建低延迟交互式智能体的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: OpenFold3 Biomolecular Structure Model Deploys via SageMaker JumpStart
item.description:
AWS has added OpenFold3-preview, the open source biomolecular structure prediction model from the OpenFold Consortium and Columbia's AlQuraishi Lab, to SageMaker JumpStart. Users can deploy it into their own AWS account with a few lines of code and predict 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA, small-molecule ligands and their complexes. The endpoint supports network isolation and asynchronous inference for computational drug discovery workflows.

原文标题：OpenFold3 上线 SageMaker JumpStart 一键部署

Why it matters：开源结构预测模型接入托管平台，降低了生物医药团队的部署门槛，具备实际工程价值。

item.title: FAA Expands AI Air Traffic Advisory System Across US Airspace
item.description:
The FAA has expanded its $875 million SMART AI advisory system from the Washington, DC region to all 22 air traffic control centers nationwide. The agency says the tool rerouted 180 flights during its initial rollout, saving roughly 10 minutes and nearly 80 gallons of fuel per flight, while the air traffic controllers' union says it was excluded from designing and testing the system.

Why it matters：这是 AI 进入国家级关键基础设施运营的实质性部署案例，兼具规模、成本与劳资争议等多重信号。

Overall net improvement score is 30.48% vs. 19.51%, with the widest gap in visual design (45.34% vs. 23.29%); Business & Finance is too close to call.

item.title: FreeBSD 15.1 Adds First Working bhyve Live Migration
item.description:
A first working live-migration implementation for bhyve guests on FreeBSD 15.1 lets a running amd64 guest move between two hosts over TCP, pausing only for the final stop-and-copy phase. Built on bhyve's experimental snapshot support, it adds dirty-page tracking to the vmm kernel module plus a migration protocol in bhyve and bhyvectl, and is published as a WIP RFC for open design feedback.

原文标题：FreeBSD 15.1 实现 bhyve 虚拟机热迁移

Why it matters：FreeBSD 虚拟化长期缺失的关键能力首次落地，对运维与云原生基础设施读者有直接参考价值。

Hacker News AI · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: Building the Most AI-Native Company Means Owning Your Context
item.description:
Greg Isenberg lays out a practical playbook for becoming the most AI-native company: build a personal second brain in Obsidian, capture voice notes via Wispr and meeting transcripts via Granola, then feed that private context to agents through CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md instruction files, cross-session memory tools like claude-mem and mem0, and an Airbyte-to-ClickHouse data pipeline. His core argument: models are identical for everyone, so proprietary context is the only defensible moat.

原文标题：打造最 AI 原生公司需构建上下文飞轮

Why it matters：提供了一套可立即落地的 AI 原生公司上下文工程方法论，工具链具体、步骤清晰，对构建智能体工作流的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Carnegie Mellon Benchmark Shows Opus 5.5 Agents Beat SGLang Production Systems
item.description:
Carnegie Mellon University released Singularity-Bench, which tasks agents with six end-to-end engineering jobs spanning pre-training pipelines, inference engines and cluster orchestration, scored against production systems like SGLang and NVIDIA Dynamo on identical GPUs. Opus 5.5 with Claude Code reached a Singularity-Index of 1.25 (1 equals the human baseline) versus a 0.58 average for the other ten agents, and its self-built serving engine earned $11.52 per GPU-hour against $8.18 for SGLang.

原文标题：卡内基梅隆新基准：Opus 5.5 智能体超越 SGLang 生产系统

Why it matters：首个以生产级系统为对照、覆盖全栈 AI 工程链路的智能体基准，且给出可量化的经济性对比，对评估智能体真实工程能力具有参考价值。

item.title: Engineers Launch No AI Slop Manifesto for AI-Assisted Work
item.description:
A group of engineers has published a No AI Slop manifesto modeled on the 2001 Agile Manifesto, asserting five value pairs such as outcomes over output, understanding over speed, and our own thinking over a model's first draft. It is an industry values statement soliciting signatures via a public Gist rather than a technical proposal.

原文标题：17 位工程师发起 No AI Slop 宣言

Why it matters：这是 AI 辅助开发时代关于工作方式与质量底线的行业价值观倡议，对重度 AI 从业者具有讨论与参照价值。

item.title: CodeRabbit 投入 100 万美元为开源维护者免费提供深度扫描
item.description:
CodeRabbit 宣布投入 100 万美元，为开源维护者免费提供 Deep Scan 安全扫描服务。该服务已覆盖 1,125 个公开仓库，发现 1,215 个高危或严重问题，其中 75 个已完成修复。Deep Scan 会先梳理仓库的入口点、信任边界与访问控制，再模拟攻击者路径进行全代码库渗透式排查。

Why it matters：以具体扫描数据揭示开源安全攻防不对称，并给出可落地的免费 AI 安全工具方案。

item.title: LangChain 完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资 估值达 30 亿美元
item.description:
AI 智能体管理平台 LangChain 完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 CapitalG 领投，估值达 30 亿美元，较一年前的 12.5 亿美元翻倍有余。公司从开源框架起家，现已转向智能体创建与管理平台 LangSmith，主打模型、云与生态中立，称已拥有 7000 家客户，包括英伟达、丰田、Salesforce 等。

Why it matters：智能体赛道头部开源公司估值一年翻倍，反映企业级 Agent 管理平台的商业化提速。

item.title: AssemblyAI 用 EC2 Spot 降低语音转写推理成本
item.description:

item.title: 发现驱动组织衰老却不引发炎症的酶
item.description:
研究人员发现一种驱动机体组织衰老的酶，通过生物工程使小鼠缺失该酶后，其年龄相关的肝组织硬化与纤维化程度下降。靶向降低该蛋白水平的药物有望延缓衰老，同时不损害免疫防御。

Why it matters：该发现指向衰老与免疫解耦的潜在药物靶点，对 AI for Science 与生物医学交叉读者具实质增量。

item.title: Depue 指控中国模型用禁运芯片 报告自承证据不足
item.description:
前 OpenAI 研究员 Will Depue 发推称 DeepSeek、月之暗面、MiniMax、蚂蚁使用禁运的 Blackwell 芯片训练最新模型，涉及超 5 亿美元芯片。但社区逐条拆解指出，其报告本身承认指纹证据只能说明权重如何创建、不能证明芯片参与训练，5 亿美元数字依赖无法证实的假设，且无法判断芯片位置与合法性。

Why it matters：涉及出口管制与国产模型算力来源的争议性指控，社区对证据链的逐条拆解具有实质信息价值。
